### 🎯 Core changes
***Required cash:** $3000 - $3500.  (🔺= great, 🔸= ok, 🔻= situational, ⚠️= very situational, consider carefully)*

***Most important stats:**  [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) → [Ability Power](stat_ability_power)*

1. **Buy** [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) 
2. **Buy** one of:
    - 🔺 [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) 
      - Your normal pick. It's **extremely** strong (and criminally underrated), providing great damage and great self-healing
      - Season 18 changed this power to last 2 seconds instead of 3, and removed its range limitation. The duration change sounds like a nerf, but in practice it might be even stronger than before. It still deals the same damage as before, just over a shorter period; this means more burst damage and self-healing, with the only drawback being that you should now be hitting a headshot every 2 seconds instead of every 3 seconds. But with a shotgun, that's not so hard!
      - **Note:** the damage-over-time does not stack on the same target, so for the most self-healing, change targets every now and then
    - ⚠️ [Chop Chop](item_6f404c88-210f-473d-a7e6-e03547a074b8) 
      - Pick this into teams that you **know** you'll be able to land a lot of axes on, or comps that might force close-range fights. Personally, I only choose this if I'm worried about a good [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49) player, since he'll force a close-range brawl, and you won't win it without more brawl ability
      - Building [Chop Chop](item_6f404c88-210f-473d-a7e6-e03547a074b8) can be a big hit to the build, making it harder to itemise effectively. **ONLY take it if you really feel like you can't get away with [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) this round**
3. **Buy** one of these combos:
    - 🔺 [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318) 
      - Choose this if you have [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) 
    - ⚠️ [Shady Spectacles](item_ef9bb72f-a56c-4fb6-a552-5abce0b943d7) and [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) 
      - Choose this if you have [Chop Chop](item_6f404c88-210f-473d-a7e6-e03547a074b8)

### ⚔️ Playstyle
**Play safe until you find your opening.** 

- [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) 
  - Use cover and jiggle peek to poke with your gun. Aim for headshots -- on the tank is fine, if needed -- to proc [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c), which provides regen from [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318) and also from its bleed. Then, once you find an opening (a major ability used, such as [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f)'s Suzu or [Sigma](hero_646d9571-c40a-4403-b6c1-fb67adb6112d)'s Rock, OR a squishy out of position who you think you can kill), engage with Shout
  - Play a little bit of distance where possible (since a good portion of your damage is from your gun). You have decent AP damage from [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418), so when you need to get in there, you should be fine -- just try to keep [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) active at all times for some survivability
- [Chop Chop](item_6f404c88-210f-473d-a7e6-e03547a074b8) 
  - Get in there! Weave Quick Melee between abilities to proc [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7), and you can feasibly 1v1 most brawl characters, like [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49). Don't go too crazy though, since getting hit by abilities like Charge or [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000)'s sleep would be... not great

1. **Buy** [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) (if you have [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c)) or [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) (if you have [Chop Chop](item_6f404c88-210f-473d-a7e6-e03547a074b8))
2. **Sell** [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6) if you have it; replace it with [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) 
    - You can keep it if you're constantly having to close-range brawl and need to force [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), but otherwise a mix is better
3. **Sell** [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) and [Shady Spectacles](item_ef9bb72f-a56c-4fb6-a552-5abce0b943d7) if you have them; replace with [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318) 
4. **Buy** [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) 
    - This might seem like a weird pick, but it's super extremely awesome and incredibly underrateed. [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) triggers the "on Weapon Damage" effect, and since its bleed ticks constantly, hitting one headshot provides all 5 stacks immediately
    - So, hit a headshot every 2 seconds (it can be on the tank if that's easier), and you gain 10% WP and 25 Health, plus 25% AP from the 5 stacks
    - Played effectively, you have **100% [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) uptime**. You're effectively sitting at 30% [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and 35% [Ability Power](stat_ability_power)  right now, which absolutely guarantees you have the most damage in the lobby

### 🎯 Core changes
***Required cash:** $10000 - $12000. (🔺= great, 🔸= ok, 🔻= situational)*

***Stat priority:** [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) → Shout range → [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) → [Ability Lifesteal](stat_ability_lifesteal) → [Weapon Lifesteal](stat_weapon_lifesteal)*

1. **Buy** one of:
    - 🔺 [Booming Voice](item_d751b552-4c3f-49d6-966b-611096fd2259) 
      - Boosts the range of your Shout, which is important for applying [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52). Also provides a decent boost to [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), which is nice since [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) scales both its damage and self-healing on [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) 
      - [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) doesn't have all of its utility yet, so for this round it's nice to just blast [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and watch it tick down enemies' health
      - **Note:** this item **does** increase the range of [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52), despite that power's description stating a static 10 meter range
    - 🔻 [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) 
      - Choose this if you can't stay alive. Soon, most heroes' damage will start ramping up, so some survivability is useful. This item keeps your stats at equal [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), so it's a nice little boost if you're already doing fine and just want a stable, steady upgrade (remember that when measuring your [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), you should add 25 from [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b))
    - 🔻 [Bloodhound Mask](item_6d47a293-5ec7-44ca-b4c5-120204757c14) 
      - Choose this if you're already able to reliably proc [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) without [Booming Voice](item_d751b552-4c3f-49d6-966b-611096fd2259), and want to build more [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) 
      - Works well with [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) and [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) since they apply a lot of wounds, but sometimes [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) needs [Booming Voice](item_d751b552-4c3f-49d6-966b-611096fd2259) to be reliable

### ⚔️ Playstyle changes
**Time to get blasting!** [Bloodhound Mask](item_6d47a293-5ec7-44ca-b4c5-120204757c14) empowers your gun (and [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c)) when you apply a Wound. As a reminder, here are your Wound sources:

- [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) 
- [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) 
- Axe
- Knife
- Melee (only if Knife is in your hand)
- Rampage (ult)

Every different source of Wounds can stack with another, except for Knife and melee, which are the same type. 

The most reliable combo is:

1. Walk into a pack of enemies, then hit a headshot to apply [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) 
2. Shout to apply [Reckoner’s Roar](item_efe615c6-8b32-4847-9d8f-4f55adaeba52) to everyone
3. Start blasting a **different** enemy to the one you headshot, creating another source of [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) and bursting them down. Follow up with abilities as needed to create more Wounds

If you have Rampage, you can add a "step 0" to the list above, which is to hit as many people as possible with your ultimate. Since it's a separate Wound type, it can stack with all the rest.

### 🎯 Core changes
*Required cash: $4000 - $5000. (🔺= great, 🔸= ok, 🔻= situational)*
1. **Buy** one of:
    - [Bloodcrazed](item_9ac9b9a7-793d-4f2f-9447-4b55ba7bc3f5)
      - My usual pick. Decent survivability that's often needed for close-range fights
    - [Bow Down](item_0673e9ed-37dd-4e58-acef-77e0fbe613fb)
      - Usable against teams that don't really have a defense for Rampage (i.e. no [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f), [Zarya](hero_be6cc516-0b7a-4515-8472-f489f08993b0), [Reaper](hero_0449752f-1c58-487b-b9a0-ca727d784457), [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed), [Mei](hero_36fd67f0-19df-4c50-add9-709cfb147cb0))
    - [Merciless Magnetism](item_4b947939-bc68-4160-9388-28432bf71909) 
      - Strong against teams with high mobility that mean you can't hit many knives (think [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768), [Mercy](hero_0e213bfc-3ca9-49c6-9036-e7f344b752da), [Juno](hero_035c63b7-084c-4abd-9de5-c9a00e9b6a18), [Freja](hero_e80840a1-845d-4008-966c-585b7cb4a424))
    - [Let’s Go Win](item_80df18f3-8530-4e55-8ea3-9ac7a3f12508) 
      - Recently nerfed to 50% instead of 100%, but still okay in combination with the rest of your CDR items and powers
      - Your 25% CDR with this power cuts the cooldown to around 5 seconds after an elim
2. Replace [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6) / [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) with one of:
      - 🔺 [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) 
        - Pick this if you want more AP
        - Comes with 10% CDR to reach the 25% breakpoint (see [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) description below for more info)
      - 🔻 [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) 
        - Pick this if you can't survive long enough
          - 3% life per second isn't *craaaaazy* good (it's probably around 20-25 HP per sec by this point in the match), but we're also here for the 10% CDR, since that takes us to the 25% CDR breakpoint needed for [Cut ‘em, Gracie!](item_83876e20-96d8-472f-9861-6682040d18a3) to be able to instantly reset knife cooldown with 1 hit and 1 dragthrough (or just 2 dragthroughs)
      - Other viable options, if you don't care about the CDR breakpoint, are [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce) (damage) and [Scav Scraps](item_b24d8c46-7022-49e2-b50d-7cc20a27fb05) (Overhealth)

### ⚔️ Playstyle changes
Okay, now you've hit 25% CDR, you need to focus on hitting knives. If you can't, take [Merciless Magnetism](item_4b947939-bc68-4160-9388-28432bf71909). Hit a knife and it's on a 2 second cooldown; drag it through someone too, and it's back with a 0 second cooldown. You only stay alive by spamming abilities, so mash that keyboard. Don't forget about good ol' [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) -- you still have decent WP, so stick with the same ability cycle of [Royal Bullets](item_3dee6c30-86d8-4d60-b877-4d78b6a6da7c) → axe → knife → repeat (shouting as needed, to engage or to back off).

Good luck!
